newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell Singapore makes lowest offer to Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Shell Singapore makes lowest offer to Sri Lanka.

text.p: Shell Singapore has made the lowest offer of 95 cents per barrel and 80 cents per barrel over spot Singapore quotes into Sri Lanka's tender to buy diesel and jet fuel respectively, an official at state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) said on Tuesday.
The offers were on a cost-and-freight basis for March 9-10 delivery to Colombo.
The tender sought 30,000-tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 7,000-tonnes of jet A-1. The tender, which attracted four offers, closed on February 25 and offers are valid for two days.
In its previous tender, CPC bought 220,000 barrels of 1.0 percent diesel and 40,000 barrels of jet A-1 at 61 cents over spot Singapore quotes on a c-and-f Colombo basis.
